nodes.label: Wav2Lip
nodes.description: ACM Multimedia 2020 lip-sync model from IIIT Hyderabad. Uses encoder-decoder architecture with 80-dim mel-spectrogram audio encoder and pre-trained SyncNet as discriminator. Outputs 96x96 face regions. Classic baseline, most widely cited lip-sync model.

metadata.paper_title: A Lip Sync Expert Is All You Need for Speech to Lip Generation In the Wild

nodes.label: SyncNet Audio-Visual Discriminator
nodes.description: Pre-trained lip-sync expert used as discriminator in Wav2Lip training and as standalone evaluation metric. Provides LSE-D and LSE-C metrics. v2 model used for evaluation (syncnet_v2.model).
